messages:
jana: Quick flag - noticed quota attribution spike for partner-orgs. digging shows sidecar is sometimes NOT adding X-Org-Id header when requests are proxied through our edge. billing shows a bunch of traffic hitting 'org-unknown'.
mike: ugh, that's the worst. any repro?
jana: yes, repro with env=staging and path /v1/stream when using the edge rewrite. logs show:
```
WARN sidecar: no org header, token present but exchange failed: ERR_NO_PROJECT_CLAIM
route: edge-proxy -> sidecar (rewrite)
```
Seems like token exchange call to auth-service times out and we drop org claim rather than retrying.
kai: timeout makes sense for short-tail requests. Right now sidecar does a single sync exchange with 50ms timeout. That's aggressive.
mike: Changing timeouts could increase p99. Can we fallback to using token 'iss' claim heuristics for attribution? maybe best-effort before declaring 'org-unknown'.
jana: I prototyped: if exchange fails, sidecar will try (1) cached mapping by token-hash, (2) decode token locally without network for stable fields, (3) if still nothing, tag as "sidecar:exchange_failed" and pass upstream with X-Attribution: unattributed.
kai: That sounds ok. Two follow-ups: we need telemetry to distinguish causes (exchange_timeout vs invalid_claim vs decode_error) AND console dashboard to show attribution source so support doesn't immediately assume user misconfigured keys.
mike: Agree. Proposed metrics: authz.sidecar.exchange.success, authz.sidecar.exchange.timeout, authz.sidecar.decode.success, authz.sidecar.attribution.fallback. Add tags: env, route, sampling_bucket.
jana: Also adding a new field on token-level usage in the billing pipeline: attribution.source = [token_claim, sidecar_local, sidecar_exchange, fallback_unattributed] so we can partition costs.
kai: For rollout plan: enable sidecar-exchange-retry for 10% of traffic on canary orgs, then 50%, then 100%. Use flag: feature.sidecar.exchange_retry and a whitelist for partner org ids.
mike: Console UX: on per-route quota page show "Attribution Confidence" with a small tooltip explaining counts from each source. This will prevent support escalations.
jana: Here is the config snippet I'm thinking for sidecar:
```
SIDEcar_EXCHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=50
SIDEcar_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=0
# canary override
FEATURE_SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=2
FEATURE_SIDECAR_CANARY_ORGS=["org-abc","org-partner-x"]
```
I'll open a PR to flip FEATURE_SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES to 2 for the canary.
infra-bot: deploy queue: svc-sidecar@canary started by jana (build 472a9).
mike: For metrics dashboard, Datadog queries:
- sum:authz.sidecar.exchange.timeout{*} by {route}
- topk(5, sum:authz.sidecar.attribution.fallback{*} by {org})
We should correlate with billing delta for those orgs.
kai: Also add a light sampling trace for the path when fallback occurs - include request_id and token-hash-annotated so we can replay safely. 1% sampling to limit perf hit.
jana: I'll add logs like:
```
info sidecar.attribution = {source: "exchange_timeout", request_id: "r-...", token_hash: "h-..."}
```
(no token values in logs).
mike: One more: edge-proxy team - can we avoid double-proxying that increases exchange latency? maybe prefer direct call from edge to auth-service for hot paths. @kai can we loop them in?
kai: tagging them in the follow-up RFC. For now let's ship canary with retries and telemetry. I'll make a dashboard card and a slack alert for if fallback rate > 0.5% over 5m.
jana: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sidecar/pull/238 - includes retry logic, metric hooks, and canary flag. requesting reviews from @mike and @kai.
mike: reviewing now, will comment on timeout vs retry backoff. small nit: don't retry on 401/4xx from auth-service.
kai: agreed. Add unit test for token decode fallback.
jana: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll monitor infra-bot deploys and post results here.
infra-bot: deploy success: svc-sidecar@canary 472a9 -> instances 8/8 healthy
jana: first 30m canary stats: exchange.timeout=120 (0.12%), attribution.fallback=45 (0.045%) - looks good but still non-zero. Will increase sampling for traces on those request_ids.
mike: OK lets keep canary at 10% for 4h, then 50% if stable. Follow-ups: (#1) console attribution column (#2) billing pipeline tag (#3) edge-proxy RFC. I'll create tickets.
kai: nice. adding to eng-platform board.
jana: closing loop when billing parity confirmed.
